doc: The comparisons experiments/STATS/paired_errors.py forms for the v2 runs (amendments A7-A13). Models are the runs of configs/arms/v2_grid.json, named as the runs are (<arm lower-cased, underscores dropped>-s<run>; the self-supervised arm's runs mpm-v2-s<run>), each at a checkpoint: bestval (the primary) or wavg (the weight average of epochs 70-79). Every contrast is formed at each checkpoint, and run k of one arm is paired with run k of another only where their training streams agree up to that checkpoint (A7). Every ratio is coarse over fine: above 1 = the coarser, merged, unseen or control side is worse. Every contrast is also formed between the checkpoints (A8: the result at wavg over the result at bestval). A new arm needs its grid entry and one line here; labels are optional (the arm name stands in). An arm decided but not yet in the grid is listed under pending_arms, and its contrasts form no row until it is; an arm named here that is neither is fatal.

labels.FLAV_F1: F0 with the four-prong b/c cut (F1)
labels.FLAV_F1R: F1 with a random four-prong cut (F1r)

contrasts.fine: 162 classes: mass output over none, lambda 5
contrasts.coarse: 17 classes: mass output over none, matched lambda

contrasts.note: P2 extended: F1 beats F1r on b vs c in two-prong decays; on the four-prong probe, the manipulation check (F1 splits bbqq/ccqq, F1r merges it)

contrasts.stream_exempt: a run that leaves the family out draws a different stream by construction (a selection on the stored label), so it cannot be stream-matched to its parent; the two arms are compared unpaired
